newsitem.title: USA: UAL says Frontier claim baseless.
newsitem.headline: UAL says Frontier claim baseless.

text.p: UAL Corp's United Airlines said on Tuesday that it would be unfortunate if what it called "baseless charges" leveled against it by a competitor led to increased government interference in the airline industry.

Earlier Tuesday, Denver-based Frontier Airlines Inc said it filed a complaint with the U.S. Department of Justice alleging that United engaged in "predatory, anticompetitive and monopolistic practices" at Denver International Airport.
Chicago-based United said it had not seen the Frontier complaint but it believed it did not contain anything that had not been addressed before.
Frontier last month complained about United and said it would seek federal action.
